howToUse: Each entry in 'images' is one picture the game shows. 'file' is where to save it, relative to pink-oyster-run/index.html.
Full prompt to send to the image model = stylePrompt + ' ' + prompt + ' ' + backgroundSuffix[background]. Use negativePrompt where the model supports it.
Generate at width x height (or any larger size with the same aspect ratio). PNG keeps transparency; WebP also works if you change the extension in 'file'.

Entries with 'alignWith' are revealed on top of that image with a growing mask, so the object must sit in the exact same place. Make them by editing the 'alignWith' image (img2img / inpaint / 'same image but...'), not from scratch.
'reveal' says which part of the canvas the growth mask sweeps over (fractions of width/height). If your art is framed differently, adjust these numbers instead of regenerating.
Missing files are fine: the game falls back to its built-in placeholder art for that id. Open the Notebook > Art tab in the game to see which files it found.
After editing this file, run: node pink-oyster-run/tools/sync-manifest.mjs  (copies it into index.html so the game also works when opened straight from disk).
stylePrompt: Cozy storybook illustration for a casual mobile game. Clean vector-like shapes, soft cel shading and gentle gradients, confident dark plum outlines (#2a1b2e). Warm palette: flamingo pink (#e2557a), deep rose (#b8325a), cream-white mycelium (#fbf8f1), honey-amber agar (#ead7a8), wheat straw (#d9b65a), sawdust brown (#8a6040). One centered subject, front view tilted slightly from above, soft contact shadow directly underneath, even studio lighting, readable at small sizes.

backgroundSuffix.transparent: Isolated subject on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha channel). Nothing else in frame.
backgroundSuffix.opaque: Full-bleed scene that fills the whole canvas. No transparency.

negativePrompt: text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, logo, signature, hands, people, faces, photorealistic, grainy noise, busy background, cropped subject, multiple separate subjects, frame, border

images.usedFor: Agar plate on a shelf before mycelium grows. Bottom layer of every plate.
images.prompt: A round glass petri dish seen from slightly above, filled with smooth, glossy honey-amber agar. Clean and empty: no growth, no spots. Small specular highlight on the upper-left rim.
images.framing: Dish centered at 50% x, 49% y. Outer rim diameter about 86% of the canvas width. Agar surface radius about 40% of the width.

images.usedFor: Revealed over plate_empty as a growing circle while the plate colonizes.
images.prompt: The exact same petri dish as the reference, now covered edge to edge in dense, fluffy cream-white mycelium, with fine ropey rhizomorphic strands radiating outward from a small square agar wedge in the center. Healthy and clean: no green, no other colors.
images.framing: Identical framing to plate_empty.

images.usedFor: Grain spawn jar before colonization (also while in the pressure cooker or waiting for spawn).
images.prompt: A quart glass mason jar with a grey metal lid that has a small round white filter patch in its center, filled about 90% with plump, hydrated golden-brown rye berries. Clean glass, kernels loose, no water pooling at the bottom.
images.framing: Jar centered. Lid top at about 8% of the height, jar bottom at about 94%. Grain fills from about 27% to 92% of the height.

images.usedFor: Revealed over jar_empty from the top down as the grain colonizes.
images.prompt: The exact same mason jar as the reference, the grain now fully colonized: every rye kernel bound together by bright cream-white mycelium, a few kernels faintly visible through the white.
images.framing: Identical framing to jar_empty.

images.usedFor: Grow bag filled with chopped straw (pasteurized or sterilized), before colonization.
images.prompt: A clear plastic mushroom grow bag standing upright, top folded flat, with a small white rectangular filter patch near the top. The bottom 60% is filled with chopped golden wheat straw pieces.
images.framing: Bag centered. Bag top at about 5%, bottom at about 95% of the height. Substrate top edge at about 39% of the height.

images.usedFor: Grow bag filled with supplemented hardwood (sawdust + bran, or Masters Mix), before colonization.
images.prompt: The exact same grow bag as the reference, but the bottom 60% is filled with dense dark-brown hardwood sawdust and pellets with lighter tan flecks of soy hulls and bran.
images.framing: Identical framing to bag_straw.

images.usedFor: Grow bag filled with coir + vermiculite (also used for the coffee-grounds event bag).
images.prompt: The exact same grow bag as the reference, but the bottom 60% is filled with dark-brown fluffy coco coir mixed with small sparkly white-grey vermiculite flecks.
images.framing: Identical framing to bag_straw.

images.usedFor: Revealed over any of the three bag images from the top down while the bag colonizes.
images.prompt: The exact same grow bag as the reference, the substrate now fully colonized into a solid cream-white block of mycelium, with faint texture of the substrate showing underneath.
images.framing: Identical framing to bag_straw / bag_sawdust.

images.usedFor: Colonized fruiting block before pins appear, and while resting between flushes.
images.prompt: A fully colonized cream-white rectangular mushroom block with the plastic bag cut away, standing upright, with a small X-shaped cut on the front center. No mushrooms yet.
images.framing: Block in the lower half: top edge at about 51%, bottom at about 95% of the height, about 42% of the width wide. X-cut centered at about 50% x, 65% y. Keep the upper half empty so clusters can grow into it.

images.usedFor: Block that is pinning (tiny primordia forming).
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with a tight cluster of tiny bright-pink mushroom pins (primordia) bursting from the X-cut.
images.framing: Identical framing to block_ready.

images.usedFor: Cluster growing toward harvest.
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with a small young cluster of pink oyster mushrooms (Pleurotus djamor) growing from the X-cut: 5 to 6 small fan-shaped caps with edges curled under, rich flamingo pink.
images.framing: Identical block framing to block_ready. The cluster may grow up into the empty upper half.

images.usedFor: Healthy cluster at peak: the harvest moment.
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with a large, perfect cluster of pink oyster mushrooms growing from the X-cut: 8 to 10 broad ruffled fan-shaped caps, edges still slightly curled down, vivid flamingo pink with deeper rose edges, short pale stems, pale-pink gills visible under the caps. Harvest-ready.
images.framing: Identical block framing to block_ready. The cluster fills most of the upper half.

images.usedFor: Cluster grown in stale, high-CO2 air (too little fresh air exchange).
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with a stretched, leggy cluster of pink oyster mushrooms: long thin pale stems reaching upward and small, undersized pink caps, the look of too little fresh air.
images.framing: Identical block framing to block_ready.

images.usedFor: Cluster grown in air that is too dry (low humidity).
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with a pink oyster cluster whose caps are dry and cracked: split edges curling upward, slightly faded pink, a few crispy brown edges, the look of low humidity.
images.framing: Identical block framing to block_ready.

images.usedFor: Cluster left past its peak; will drop if not picked.
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, with an overripe pink oyster cluster: caps flattened and turned up at the edges, color faded to washed-out pale pink, wavy edges, and a fine dusting of pale spores on the block below.
images.framing: Identical block framing to block_ready.

images.usedFor: Block after its flushes are used up, waiting to be retired.
images.prompt: The exact same block as the reference, now tired and spent: shrunken, dented, slightly yellowed tan-cream, with a couple of small dried brown mushroom stubs at the X-cut.
images.framing: Identical framing to block_ready.

images.usedFor: Drawn on top of any plate, jar or bag when contamination becomes visible. Opacity and size grow with the infection.
images.prompt: Only patches of green Trichoderma mold and nothing else: 5 to 7 fuzzy round colonies, dark emerald-green centers fading to a soft white fuzzy ring at the edges, scattered across the middle of the frame.
images.framing: Patches stay inside the central 60% of the canvas. Transparency everywhere else is essential: this layer sits on top of other images.

images.usedFor: Icon for the fresh-harvest crate.
images.prompt: A small woven wicker basket heaped with fresh, bright pink oyster mushroom clusters.
images.framing: Basket centered, filling about 85% of the canvas.

images.usedFor: Icon for dehydrated mushrooms.
images.prompt: A small glass jar with a cork lid filled with dried, shriveled tan and faded-pink oyster mushroom pieces.
images.framing: Jar centered, filling about 85% of the canvas.

images.usedFor: Icon for the pressure cooker (sterilizer) widget.
images.prompt: A stovetop aluminum pressure cooker with a round pressure gauge on the lid and two black handles, a small puff of steam rising from the valve.
images.framing: Pot centered, filling about 85% of the canvas.

images.usedFor: Title screen illustration.
images.prompt: A cozy small home mushroom grow room in the evening: wooden shelves holding petri dishes, mason jars of white grain spawn and grow bags; in the foreground right, a large vivid pink oyster mushroom cluster fruiting from a cream block; soft warm lamp light and a little humidifier mist; pastel pink and cream palette.
images.framing: Wide 16:9 scene. Main cluster in the right half.
